request.text: Sit. You've walked far enough to be listened to. We barred our door to him, and he gave it to you. Of course he did. Twelve shards in their halls. And the Eye's last piece walks. You. You're what it's been walking towards. There it is. The frame takes whatever of the Eye it's brought. Choose. The last entry. The others have gone down to sleep with the old Keepers. I stay to write, because someone should.
request.voice_description: Native English, British. Male, 75-85. Excellent quality. Persona: the eldest of an order of hermit scholars who have guarded an ancient gate at the edge of the world for generations. Emotion: grave, weary, stern, with a dry, bitter wisdom and a buried kindness. An old, thin, dry but steady voice, slow and deliberate, every word weighed; the voice of a man who has outlived everyone he knew.
